recipes.title: Butter Chicken
recipes.source_fidelity: Ingredient lists and timing/temperature facts are taken from the linked source where available; method wording is paraphrased for offline beginner use.
ingredients: 750 g chicken thigh fillets, cut bite-size
1/2 cup plain yoghurt, full fat preferred
2 tbsp ghee, butter or neutral oil
1 cup tomato passata or tomato puree
Basmati rice, coriander and/or flatbread to serve

recipes.australian_shop_notes: Most ingredients should be available from Coles, Woolworths or IGA; check Asian grocers for listed specialty items.

method_steps.visual_or_texture_cue: Chicken is evenly coated in orange yoghurt marinade.

method_steps.instruction: Cover and refrigerate the chicken.
method_steps.visual_or_texture_cue: Minimum 3 hours; overnight is best; source allows up to 24 hours.

method_steps.visual_or_texture_cue: Pan should be hot before chicken goes in.

method_steps.instruction: Cook the chicken, stirring/turning, until the outside turns white all over.
method_steps.visual_or_texture_cue: Chicken will not deeply brown because of the yoghurt marinade.

method_steps.instruction: Add passata, cream, sugar, salt and any remaining marinade from the bowl. Reduce to low and simmer.
method_steps.visual_or_texture_cue: Sauce thickens and deepens from pale orange to richer orange.

method_steps.instruction: Taste and add salt if needed. Serve with rice, coriander and/or flatbread.
